title: AARO fishes for the program name and the people on it

tellings.quote: They wanted me to name the people that I knew that were working on the program. I refused to do it and they wanted the name of the program.

plain: In 2023 AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into UFO reports, pressed a man named Dylan Borland to give up the name of a secret programme and the people working on it, Borland tells Michels. He says: "They wanted me to name the people that I knew that were working on the program. I refused to do it." He tells it as a sign that the office was hunting for insiders rather than simply taking his account.
